A supplementary subset limited to exactly those 41 characters was built with fontTools from the same Source Han Serif SC Regular input already registered under RIGHTS-SOURCE-HAN-SERIF-OFL-20260828 (release 2.003R), renamed under the Open Font License in the same way as JZ Offline CJK 186H - name IDs 1, 2, 3, 4 and 6 rewritten so the Reserved Font Name is not used, name IDs 0, 13 and 14 preserved - and appended to visual/assets/offline-cjk-font.css as a second @font-face named "JZ Offline CJK Supp 0831".

The subset is built with fontTools, which stamps a build timestamp, so rebuilding from the same input does not reproduce the same output bytes; the hash recorded here is the measured hash of the embedded subset.
